case.summary: Transaction 3464869 for $599.94 on card C03042-K1 (online, product R) on 2016-11-17 14:03 is assessed as legitimate at fraud probability 0.03. Device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050' was used by 1 other card(s) in the surrounding window (C05704-K1); 8 distinct cards have used it across the dataset. Device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050': device profile not seen on this card before; identity record marks the device 'New' for this account. The device profile links this card to 1 other card held by unrelated customers, so the compromise is wider than this alert. Closed cases CC-0615, CC-1313, CC-3886 were retrieved as memory and used to weigh the evidence. Recommended: ALLOW_TRANSACTION, CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
